name: Check Ports, Sysctls, IPv6
description: Reads back from the running container what the init wrapper (/usr/local/sbin/proxvex-init) was asked to set: the lowest port a non-root app may open (unprivileged_port_start), the container_sysctls values, the IPv6 token on eth0, and that a non-root app was dropped back to its own user. Passes as 'not needed' when the wrapper was skipped for a port setting alone (image without shell or privilege-drop tool); fails when requested sysctls or a token are missing.
